verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly claim the capability to 'trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start' (cursor-docs-1), and project rules can 'encode domain-specific knowledge about your codebase' (cursor-docs-35), which support codebase-understanding for onboarding/navigation. However, the evidence pack lacks deeper mechanism detail (e.g., codebase indexing, semantic search, @-file/@-codebase chat context) or independent corroboration of how well this actually works in practice. Missing for 10: detailed docs on codebase indexing/semantic search features, hands-on/independent validation that navigation actually helps developers find the right starting point, and coverage of large/legacy codebase scenarios.
